description: This file defines the TbAnalogueCompass class, a custom gauge component for displaying a compass using the canvas-gauges library within the Thingsboard platform. It includes configuration for visual appearance, needle behavior, and animations.

classes.name: TbAnalogueCompass
classes.description: A gauge component representing an analogue compass, extending the base gauge class with specific configuration for compass display.

methods.name: createGaugeOptions
methods.description: Generates configuration options for the radial gauge, including major/minor ticks, needle appearance, colors, fonts, and animations based on provided settings.

methods.name: createGauge
methods.description: Creates and returns a new RadialGauge instance with the specified gauge data.
